Dünya, 13 Sep 2025 (https://www.dunya.com/sirketler/tmsf-flash-tvyi-satisa-cikardi-ihale-sureci-basladi-iste-fiyati-ve-sartlari-haberi-793923): appraised value TL 84 million, deposit TL 8.4 million. Neither says why or since when TMSF is trustee. A search for the tender result returned only the earlier announcements. No official page reached (TMSF and RTÜK block automated reading). Verifier: TMSF sale notice and result, RTÜK licence record for the current licensee, and the Trade Registry Gazette for Göktuğ Multimedya Yayıncılık AŞ.
